htmlLang.description: BCP 47 tag of this file's own language, used for the document's lang attribute. Not a translation: set it to this locale's own code.

portInvalid.message: The port has to be a whole number between 1 and 65535.

protocolInsecure.message: HTTP sends your password and session id unencrypted. Using HTTPS is recommended, so the data travels encrypted.
protocolInsecure.description: Shown under the protocol selector while HTTP is chosen.

hostIpCert.message: With HTTPS the certificate has to match the address you entered. If your NAS certificate only covers a host name, use that name instead of the IP address.
hostIpCert.description: Shown under the address while HTTPS is chosen and the host is a bare IP.

extensionDescription.message: Send links, magnet links and torrent links to Synology Download Station and manage your downloads right in Firefox – without opening DSM.
extensionDescription.description: Short description shown in the add-ons manager.

taskActionUnconfirmed.message: The NAS did not confirm the result for $COUNT$ task(s) — check the list before trying again.

taskListStale.message: The task list was out of date and has been refreshed. Try again.

addConnectionChanged.message: The connection settings changed before sending, so nothing was added.

retryLinkKept.message: The failed task was removed, but adding it again did not work: $REASON$ The link has been put back in the Links list.

retryLinkKeptUnsent.message: The NAS did not confirm the deletion, so nothing was added again. The link has been put back in the Links list — check the tasks on the NAS before adding it.
retryLinkKeptUnsent.description: Retry where the delete went unconfirmed, so no replacement was created.

retryLinkKeptUnknown.message: The original task was removed. Whether the new one was created is unknown — check the task list before adding it again. The link has been put back in the Links list.
retryLinkKeptUnknown.description: Retry where the delete succeeded but the answer to the new create never arrived.

retryLinkKeptSwitched.message: The original task was removed. No new task was created, because the connection it belonged to has since been changed or ended. The link has been put back in the Links list.
retryLinkKeptSwitched.description: Retry where the delete was carried out and the connection was changed, signed out of, or had its credentials replaced before a replacement could be created.

actionResultUnknown.message: The NAS did not confirm the result — check the task list before trying again.
actionResultUnknown.description: A pause, resume or delete whose answer never arrived.

addFilesHint.message: Torrent or NZB file: right-click its link and choose "Download with Download Station". The NAS fetches it.

setAsHome.message: Open the popup on this tab

errNasUnreachable.message: The NAS did not respond. It may be asleep or unreachable.

errCertificate.message: The secure connection to the NAS failed. Firefox reports: “$REASON$” Check the NAS address and the certificate.
errCertificate.description: Shown when the browser itself turned the request down over the certificate. $REASON$ is the browser's own wording, already translated, and is quoted rather than restated.

REASON.example: Requested domain name does not match the server's certificate.

connProblemSecure.description: Heading of the connection panel in the popup when the browser itself turned the connection down.

connProblemAddress.description: The address the failure happened at, scheme, host and port only.

connProblemLastAttempt.message: Last attempt: the NAS did not respond.
connProblemLastAttempt.description: Shown when the most recent attempt was an ordinary network failure and the reason below it is kept from an earlier one.

connProblemReason.description: The browser's own wording, already translated, quoted rather than restated.

REASON.example: Requested domain name does not match the server's certificate.

connProblemEarlier.message: On an earlier attempt Firefox reported: “$REASON$”
connProblemEarlier.description: The same wording, named as older news so it does not read as a cause confirmed again just now.

REASON.example: Requested domain name does not match the server's certificate.

connProblemAdvice.message: Check the NAS address and the certificate.

addBusyHint.message: Adding downloads… You can copy the links. Editing is available when adding finishes.

addBusy.message: Links are already being added. Please wait.

linksFailed.message: $COUNT$ link(s) could not be added. They are still in the list.

linksFailedReason.message: $COUNT$ link(s) could not be added: $REASON$ They are still in the list.

linkHasComma.message: A link containing a comma cannot be sent: the NAS reads commas as the separator between links.
linkHasComma.description: Shown for a link turned down before anything was sent, because the Download Station API would split it into two.

linksUncertain.message: Adding $COUNT$ link(s) was not confirmed. Check Tasks before adding them again.
linksUncertain.description: The NAS may have answered without that answer being readable, so this says what was not confirmed rather than claiming it did not answer.

confirmDeleteAll.message: Delete all tasks? Running downloads are cancelled and this cannot be undone.

setupRequired.message: Set up the connection first — host, username and password are required.

fillRequiredField.message: Please fill in the required field: $FIELD$.

fillRequiredFields.message: Please fill in the required fields: $FIELDS$.

taskRefreshInterval.message: Task list refresh in the popup

refreshIntervalHint.message: How often the open Tasks tab reloads the list, while there are active tasks — once everything is finished or paused, refreshing stops on its own. For half a minute after an add it reloads every 3 seconds regardless. Background monitoring is separate: it checks once a minute until the downloads it is watching are done, including on "Manual only".

sortStatus.description: One option of the "Sort tasks by" selector, which already says "by".

statusOrderHint.message: Drag the handle or use the arrows. The status groups appear in the order set here.
statusOrderHint.description: Deliberately says nothing about page 1: with many tasks, or sorted another way, the first group need not fit on it.

otpHint.message: Six digits from your authenticator app. Later sign-ins need no code for as long as DSM keeps trusting this device.

extractArchivesHint.message: Adds an archive-password field next to the link list. The extraction itself is the NAS's job: in DSM, open Download Station > Settings > Auto extract. There, tick "Enable Auto extract for downloaded files". Every account sets that for itself, and it is off by default.

archivePasswordHint.message: Applies to the links you add in this window, not to links added by right-click. The extension does not store it - but the NAS does: DSM adds it to its Password List and tries it on later archives.

keepaliveHint.message: Keeps an existing NAS session alive with regular background requests. This can stop the NAS hard drives from going to sleep.

destinationHint.message: Path starting with the shared folder's name, no leading slash (e.g. "downloads/series", not "/downloads/series" or "/volume1/downloads/series"). Leave empty to use the default destination already configured on the NAS itself (DSM → Download Station → Settings → General).

addNotListed.message: The NAS answered, but the download was not found in its task list.
addNotListed.description: Shown after a create went unanswered and the task list, which did answer, does not have the link. Where nothing answered at all, addNasUnreachable says so instead.

addNasUnreachable.message: The NAS is not reachable, so whether the download arrived could not be checked.

appVersion.description: Extension version at the foot of the Settings tab.

confirmResetAll.message: Reset all settings? Credentials, connection details and every option are deleted. Downloads on the NAS are not touched.

logoutHint.message: Signs out the current NAS session. Deletes the username, password and device token locally. Device trust saved in DSM remains in place and can be revoked there separately. The NAS address and options remain saved.

notificationsHint.message: System messages outside the popup. Problems that stop the extension working at all — signing in, or the destination folder — are reported regardless of these settings.

notifyWatchResult.description: Heading for a finished watch that ended with paused tasks but no failures, where "all downloads finished" would contradict the tally below it.

notifyAddUnconfirmed.description: Notification title when an unanswered add cannot be checked. The body names the lookup failure; the title must retain the uncertain add outcome even if that body is truncated.

notifyCertificate.message: The secure connection to the NAS failed. The reason is under Settings → Connection.
notifyCertificate.description: Notification body. Deliberately short: a notification shows one line and cuts off the rest, and the browser's own reason is regularly longer than that.

notifyWaking.message: The connection to the NAS could not be made yet. Another attempt follows.
notifyWaking.description: Shown while the NAS is being woken. Deliberately names no cause: a parked disk, a DNS failure and a 503 all end up here.

notifyUncertain.message: Adding was not confirmed. Check Tasks before adding the link again.

notifyBulkUncertainCount.message: $COUNT$ uncertain — check Tasks before adding them again.

detail_broken_link.message: The link is broken or no longer available.

detail_destination_not_exist.message: The destination folder does not exist.

detail_destination_denied.message: No permission to write to the destination folder.

detail_quota_reached.message: The account's storage quota is used up.

detail_exceed_max_file_system_size.message: The file is larger than the file system allows.

detail_exceed_max_destination_size.message: The file exceeds the destination folder's size limit.

detail_exceed_max_temp_size.message: The file exceeds the temporary folder's size limit.

detail_encrypted_name_too_long.message: The encrypted file name is too long.

detail_name_too_long.message: The file name is too long.

detail_torrent_duplicate.message: This torrent is already in the task list.

detail_file_not_exist.message: The source file does not exist.

detail_required_premium_account.message: This file host requires a premium account.

detail_not_supported_type.message: This file or link type is not supported.

detail_try_it_later.message: The file host asked to try again later.

detail_task_encryption.message: The task is encrypted and cannot be processed.

detail_missing_python.message: Python is missing on the NAS — install it from Package Center.

detail_ftp_encryption_not_supported_type.message: This FTP encryption type is not supported.

detail_extract_failed_invalid_archive.message: The archive is damaged or not a valid archive.

detail_extract_failed_quota_reached.message: Extracting stopped — storage quota used up.

detail_extract_failed_disk_full.message: Extracting stopped — the volume is full.

err101.message: Invalid request sent to the NAS.

err102.message: This API is not available on the NAS.

err104.message: This NAS's DSM version does not support this feature.

err105.message: This account does not have permission to do that.

err107.message: Logged out because another session logged in with the same account.

errAuth403.message: A two-step verification code is required. Open Settings to enter it.

errTask400.message: The NAS could not accept this file or link.

errTask401.message: Maximum number of download tasks reached on the NAS.

errTask402.message: Destination folder access denied — check that this account has read/write permission on it.

errTask403.message: Destination folder not found — check the folder name (Settings tab) and that this account has permission to see it.

errTask403NoDest.message: The default destination configured on the NAS itself does not exist, or this account cannot see it. Enter a valid folder under Settings → Default destination, or fix it in DSM under Download Station → Settings → General.

errTask404.message: Task not found (it may already have been removed on the NAS).

errTask405.message: That action is not valid for this task right now.

errTask406.message: No default destination is set. Set one in DSM under Download Station → Settings → General, or fill in "Default destination" in this extension's Settings tab.

errTask407.message: Failed to set the destination folder.
